title: Reeves to Deliver Mansion House Speech: What to Expect
content: UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Rachel Reeves will highlight plans to spur homeownership by easing access to mortgages in her flagship annual address to the City of London. Reeves will announce a permanent mortgage guarantee scheme and more home loans for people on lower incomes, according to a statement from the Treasury. She will speak at the event alongside Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey. Bloomberg’s James Woolcock reports.
